summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, a BVI-incorporated, Beijing-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the September 25, 2026 closing of an over-allotment tranche in its registered direct offering. Certain investors exercised the over-allotment option for 550,000 Class A shares at $1.50 per share plus 550,000 warrants at $2.75, raising roughly $825,000 gross. The tranche supplements the September 18 initial offering of 10,000,000 shares and warrants, under an aggregate $15,000,000 cap. Appleby rendered the validity opinion; no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and dilution.
